shortDescription: Hong Kong's New World Development HKEX:17 said on Wednesday it had increased its facility agreement with Deutsche Bank AG XETR:DBK to HK$4.9 billion ($624.48 million) from HK$3.95 billion, expanding the deal it signed in June.Separately, it announced it had terminated its contractual agreements wit…

children: said on Wednesday it had increased its facility agreement with Deutsche Bank AG
to HK$4.9 billion ($624.48 million) from HK$3.95 billion, expanding the deal it signed in June.
Separately, it announced it had terminated its contractual agreements with Airport Authority Hong Kong for the 11 SKIES project, an airport mall in Hong Kong.
